picker.trigger: Send an invoice, pay link, proposal, or contract

hints.invoice: Pick one to add as a PDF (with its pay link) to your message — then review and send.
hints.link: Pick one to drop its payment link into the chat.
hints.contract: Pick a contract to send for e-signature — the host gets a link to review and sign.
hints.proposal: Pick a saved template to send into the chat. Create them in Files.

empty.invoice: No unpaid invoices. Create one in Files → Invoices.
empty.link: No active pay links. Create one in Files → Pay Links.
empty.contract: No saved contracts. Create one in Files → Contracts.
empty.proposal: No saved proposals. Create one in Files → Proposals.

editor.contractHint: Complete any [brackets] (e.g. [Total Amount]), then send it for e-signature.
editor.proposalHint: Complete any [brackets] (e.g. [Total Amount]), then send it for the client to review and accept.
editor.unfilledContract: Heads up — there are still unfilled [placeholders] in the contract.
editor.unfilledProposal: Heads up — there are still unfilled [placeholders] in the proposal.

sentProposals.title: Sent proposals
sentProposals.empty: No proposals sent yet. Compose one on the left and send it from the box below.
sentProposals.confirmVoid: Void "{{title}}"? The client won't be able to accept it.

sentContracts.title: Sent for signature
sentContracts.empty: No contracts sent yet. Compose one on the left and send it from the box below.
sentContracts.confirmVoid: Void "{{title}}"? The recipient won't be able to sign it.
